notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms: Update - Patch 2.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]
Thank you for your continuous supports and feedback on Survivors: Three Kingdoms.

We are excited to introduce new skills for today's update in Survivors: Three Kingdoms!
We have also adjusted a lot of balance system in the game based on your feedback and opinions.

[b][Early Access UPDATE - Patch 2.1][/b]

[b][Correcting the dungeon error][/b]
Correction of errors in dungeons above 80 floors that do not end the game
[b]
[Adjusting the difficulty level of dungeon][/b]
Decrease in difficulty of dungeons over 46 floors

[b][Changed the logic of acquiring artifacts][/b]
At least one character is played 100% for the first time (from 1 to 4 stars)
* 3 or more do not guarantee 100% acquisition.

Thank you.

notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms: Update - Patch 2.0
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]
Thank you for your continuous supports and feedback on Survivors: Three Kingdoms.

We are excited to introduce new skills for today's update in Survivors: Three Kingdoms!
We have also adjusted a lot of balance system in the game based on your feedback and opinions.

Check the details of our new update below!

[Early Access UPDATE - Patch 2.0]

[b][Special skills] [/b]
Transcendency has been updated for all characters.
Achieving certain skills up to level 10 is a transition period.


[b][Dungeon system] [/b]
A new type of dungeon has been updated.
Difficulty increases with the number of floors.


[b][Artifact] [/b]
A relic item that can be obtained in the dungeon has been produced.
The relics can be obtained through the dungeon boss.
Relics have been added from 1 to 5.
Depending on the relics, the character can be strengthened, and up to three relics can be strengthened.
You can wear it.

[b][Functional improvement] [/b]
All melee characters are moving and attackable.
* Check it out with your own play.
Add Hell Difficulty Level
Boss AI Improvement

[b][Balance] [/b]
All skills and options have been adjusted with the dungeon and artifact systems.
The balance patch will continue to proceed.
We will inform you of the modifications after this version separately.

Thank you.

notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms: Update - Patch 1.4
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]

Thank you for your continuous supports and feedback on Survivors: Three Kingdoms.

We are excited to introduce new skills for today's update in Survivors: Three Kingdoms!
We have also adjusted a lot of balance system in the game based on your feedback and opinions.

Check the details of our new update below!

[Early Access UPDATE - Patch 1.4]
[b]
[NEW SKILL][/b]
1. Vampire
 - You can restore some of HP from attacking damages to enemies for a short time.
 - No need to clear unlock mission! Just access to the game and get a new skill! 

2. Embrace
 - Make nearby enemies into your ally and fight together.
 - Unlock Mission: Total Play Counts: 15 times or above

[b][Skill Balance][/b]
1. Explosion
 - The blast radius has increased.
 - Attack damage has slightly decreased.

2. Wall
 - The number of wall has increased by 1 for each level.
 - A lasting time for wall has been decreased by 1 second.

3. Bow attack
 - The number of shooting arrows has slightly decreased.

4. Crossbow
 - The number of shooting arrows has slightly decreased.

5. Molotov cocktail
 - A lasting time for molotov cocktail has been increased by 20%.

6. Piercing Power
 - Additional 1 piercing point will be applied to each level. 
   (Total 9 piercing points will be applied at level 9)

7. Phoenix
 - Summon 3 phoenixes at level 1. (Can summon upto 15 phoenixes at level 9)
 - The skill cooldown has been reduced from 5 to 4 seconds.

8. Soul Attack
- The skill cooldown will be reduced once you reach the certain stage. 
  + Level 1 ~ 7: 4 seconds
  + Level 8 ~ 9: 3 seconds

9. Fire Ball
- Attack damage has slighly decreased.

10. Catapult
- The number of throwing stone has increased by 1 for each level. (Can throw 9 stones at level 9)

11. Ice Arrow
- The skill cooldown has been reduced from 30 to 20 seconds.
- Attack damage has increased.

12. Roar
- The skill cooldown has been reduced from 30 to 20 seconds.

13. Healing
- The skill cooldown has been reduced from 30 to 20 seconds.

14. Dagger
- Attack damage has slighly decreased.

[b][Stage Balance][/b]
Stage 1: Storm in Afterlife
 - The number of enemies has been increased.
Stage 2: Invisible Battlefield
 - New Monster has been added. It has high HP and does strong attack. It is also resistant to knowback and debuff.
  
[b][Mission][/b]
The requirements for unlocking some skills and Adjutants have been reduced.
- Skill: War Wagon, Energy Wave, Rolling Shot, Piercing Power, Wall, Invincible Armor, Barrier, Ice Arrow, Sonic Speed, Jack Frost, Knockback Power
- Adjutant: Shieldbearer, Zhang Zhao, Meng You, Meng Huo, Xu Chu, Pang De
 

[b][Graphic/Animation][/b]
1. Design for a monster "Wisp" has changed.
2. Design for a monster "Ghost" has changed. 
3. Animation for shooting multiple arrows by an enemy "Archer"
[b]
[Extra] [/b]
1. A starting character has changed to "Xiahou Yuan"
 - "Guan Yu" will be locked and need to unlock by clearing a mission.
2. The benefit of "Ginseng" is added on Treasure Chest.


We will be waiting for more feedback!
Thank you.

notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms: Update - [Patch 1.3]
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]

Thank you for your continuous supports and feedback on Survivors: Three Kingdoms. 

We are excited to introduce a new character from Three Kingdoms for today's update! 
Not only that, but we have also adjusted some balance system for characters and skills based on your feedback and opinions through discussions and reviews. 

Check the details of our new update below!

[b][Early Access UPDATE - Patch 1.3][/b]

[b][NEW Character][/b]
Huang Yueying
 - How to Unlock: Kill more than 5,000 enemies with Zhuge Liang
 - If you have played with Zhuge Liang before, you can easily unlock Huang Yueying!

[b][Character Balance] [/b]
1. Zhuge Liang
 - Removed 'melee attack'
 - Piercing will apply to "Phoenix" skill: Level 7,8, and 9.
2. Da Qiao
 - "Da Qiao Combo" will attack 2 times in a row starting at Level 1 (Max. skill level is 6).
 - Attack speed of "Da Quiao Combo" increased.
 - Knockback power of "Da Quiao Combo" increased.
3. Zhang Fei
 - Maximum Level of "Zhang Fei Combo" increased to 5. 
 - Attacking range of "Zhang Fei Combo" increased.
 - A delay after attacks from "Zhang Fei Combo" decreased. 
 - Attack speed of "Zhang Fei Combo" increased. 
 - Knockback power of "Zhang Fei Combo" increased.
4. Zhang Jiao
 - Removed 'melee attack'
 - Moving Speed increased from -10% to 0. 

[b][Skill Balance][/b]
1. Explosion 
 - A delay in exploding motion decreased. 
2. Energy Wave
 - Knockback distance increased.
3. Soul Attack
 - Level 2: attack in 4 directions
 - Level 5: attack in 8 directions
 - Level 9: attack in 16 directions

[b][Stage Balance][/b]
Stage 3: The Wild Land
 - Difficulty level has been decreased. 
 - Enemies's attack and defense decreased.
 - Cavalryman's attack decreased. Distances between cavalrymen increased.

[b][Adjutants][/b]
Attack motions of adjutant have been modified. 


We will be waiting for more feedback!
Thank you.

notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms: Update - Patch 1.2
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]
Greetings to players,

Thanks for your attention and feedback regarding 'Survivors: Three Kingdoms'.
We fixed some bugs and balance, please check blow:


[b][Early Access UPDATE - Patch 1.2][/b]


[b][UI/UX][/b]

- Add direction and name for Bosses and Adjutants.
- Mark the maximum level when selecting Adjutants.
- The 'HP restore' items remain on the field, until you get it.


[b][Character Balance][/b]

1. Guan yu
- Revised the Attack counts of 'Guan Yu Combo':
	+ Lv.7 -> Attack 7 times
	+ Lv.8 -> Attack 8 times
	+ Lv.9 -> Attack 10 times
2. Xiahou Yuan
- Increased slightly Attack of Xiahou Yuan's Multi-attack
3. Zhang Fei
- Increased the probability of Zhang Fei's Basic Attack appearance
- Increased the probability of Zhang Fei's Dodge Power from -10% to 0
- Increased Zhang Fei's Moving Speed from -5% to 0
- Reduced amount of Zhang Fei's Skill Cooldown from -10% to 0
- Adjusted the distance of Zhang Fei Combo's Dash
- Added 'Gathering Power' of Zhang Fei
3.  Zhang Jiao
- Reduced the speed of HP decreasing from -35 to 0
- Added 'Power up', 'HP Auto-Recovery' and 'EXP Power' of Zhang Jue
4. Da Qiao
- Increased the Basic Energy of Da Qiao from -50% to -30%
- Reduced the Moving Speed slightly from 25% to 20%
- Added 'Gathering Power' of Da Qiao
5. Zhuge Liang
- Increased the Basic Energy of Zhuge Liang from -50% to -30%
- Added 'Power up' and 'Dodge Rate' of Zhuge Liang


[b][Skill Balance]
[/b]
- Increased the probability of appearing "skills" in 'Treasure Chest'
- 'Ginseng' item is added to 'Treasure Chest'. It will restore HP.
- Increased the Skill Cooldown of 'Fearsome' in the low-level section
- Increased the Skill Cooldown of 'Wall'
- Increased the Spinning speed of 'Fire Ball'
- Reduced the Damage of 'Fire Ball' silghtly
- Increased the Moving distance of 'Rolling Attack'
- Reduced the Skill Cooldown of 'Rolling Attack'
- Reduced Piercing numbers of 'Da Qiao's Dagger' from 4 to 1:
	+ But Piercing can be added through 'Power up'

[b]
[Extra][/b]

- Adjusted the effect of 'Da Qiao's Dagger'
- Revised the condition of 'Coin Flip':
	+ (existed) 10,000 Gold
	+ (changed) 5,000 Gold


[b][Bugs][/b]
- Fixed that the character's moving speed suddenly increased
- Fixed that UI information is not visible in a particular language:
	+ It is occurred to the players who use German and Spanish


[b]*REWARDS*
Players whose game record reaches V1.1 after the first purchase will receive 100,000 gold coins[/b]

notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms: First Update - Patch 1.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]

Thank you all for playing and enjoying Survivors: Three kingdom!
We also appreciate all your precious feedback and opinions on our game from the start of the Early Access.

Let us introduce our first update - Patch 1.1: modified the game contents based on feedback
[b]
[Early Access – Patch 1.1][/b]

[b][Skill Balance][/b]
Increase Efficiency for "Molotov cocktail" Skill
  - 5 Molotov cocktails will be thrown to enemies at Level 1. 
  - Increase the number of molotov cocktails by 1 as upgrade to the next level
  - Fire from molotov cocktails will last for 1 second.

[b][Mission][/b]
1. Lower the requirements for unlocking main characters.
2. Requirement for Unlocking "Healing" (Missions - Unlock Healing) has been changed.
    - BEFORE: Cumulative Numbers of HP Restore: 15,000 Points or above
    - AFTER: Cumulative Numbers of HP Restore: 10,000 Points or above
3. Requirement for Unlocking "Dagger" (Missions - Unlock Dagger) has been changed.
    - BEFORE: Total Number of Enemy Kill Counts with SKill Da Qiao's Dagger: More than 10,000 kills
    - AFTER: Total Number of Enemy Kill Counts with SKill Da Qiao's Dagger: More than 5,000 kills
3. Requirement for Unlocking "Bonus Gold" (Missions - Unlock Bonus Gold) has been changed.
    - BEFORE: Total Number of Golds Earned: Above 99,999 golds
    - AFTER: Total Number of Golds Earned: Above 10,000 golds

[b][Character Balance][/b]
1. Lower the prices for "Power UP" of each character.
2. Zhang Fei's status has been increased.
   - Moving Speed changed from [u]-10% to -5%[/u].
   - EXP Gain changed from [u]-10% to 0%.[/u]
3. Zhang Jiao's status has been increased.
   - Auto HP Restore changed from [u]-35 to -30.[/u]
4. Xiahou Yuan's status has been increased.
   - Auto HP Restore changed from [u]1 to 3.[/u]
   - Attack changed to [u]-3% to 0%.[/u]
5. Zhuge Liang's status has been increased.
   - Auto HP Restore changed from [u]0 to 2.[/u]

[b][Stage][/b]
Invisible Battlefield has been modified.
  - Mowed the lawn and adjust the distances between the grass
    (Enhance the visibility) 


We will be waiting for more feedback! 
Thank you.

notes.title: Survivors: Three Kingdoms, Early Access is now OPEN!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43121208/91d08c95e105c39ac8919abb6a28ebb32bc1daeb.png[/img]

[h1][/h1][b]“Survivors: Three Kingdoms”[/b] is now released as [b]Early Access in Steam.[/b]
We are happy to introduce our game in Steam. We want to work together with you and continuously develop our game to make better and more dynamic.

Survive and Defeat Enemies with famous heroes from Three Kingdoms! 

[b][Early Access – Patch 1.0] [/b]
-	6 Main Characters
-	12 Stages (3 Main Stages with 4 Difficulty Levels)
-	51 Skills
-	60+ Missions/Achievements

Please enjoy our game! We will be waiting for your feedback and opinions.
